result.topic_en: A Latin note on deriving differential equations from the forms a function can take, followed by a faint pencil draft letter to 'His Excellency' about an evaluation of the widows' fund (Wittwen-Institut), its balance statement of 1 July 1856 showing a surplus of 3594 Thaler, and the need for further data.
